features:
Key Features:

Flavor Profile: A rich blend of creamy white chips and buttery macadamia nuts.

Easy Preparation: Just add softened butter and an egg—mix, drop onto a baking sheet, and bake.

Quick Bake Time: Ready in about 12–14 minutes.

Generous Yield: Makes approximately 20–22 cookies per pouch.

Pantry Friendly: Shelf-stable mix ideal for quick baking needs.

Core Ingredients: Includes enriched flour, sugar, white chips, macadamia nuts, palm oil, and leavening agents.

Benefits:

Convenient: No need to measure multiple ingredients—ideal for quick treats or last-minute baking.

Delicious Combination: Sweet white chocolate pairs perfectly with the subtle crunch of macadamia nuts.

Kid & Crowd Approved: Great for parties, lunchboxes, or family baking time.

Reliable Results: Soft and chewy texture with crisp edges every time.

Versatile Use: Can be enhanced with extra nuts or chips for a customized touch.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Brown Sugar, White Confectionery Chips (sugar, vegetable oil [palm kernel and/or palm], nonfat milk, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Sugar, Macadamia Nuts, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
